name: cli-tools
description: Python or Shell automation tools, GitHub API helpers, headless-friendly scripts. Targets developers building CLI utilities, dependency analyzers, code-mod tooling, or ops automation that runs in CI/cron without a UI. Filters out application/UI/mobile/infra-heavy skills (React, Next.js, Flutter, Proxmox, OPNsense, mobile-release, frontend-design, conversion optimization, UI testing). Bundles ZERO marketplace plugins at v1 — CLI-specific plugins (gh API helpers, packaging, distribution) will be added incrementally as validated. Defaults reflect headless usage (no Docker, no MCP).
outOfScope: Web application development (use the nextjs preset)
Infrastructure-as-code (use the homelab-proxmox preset for homelab IaC)
Mobile / desktop apps (community contributions wanted for flutter, swift, tauri)
GUI testing patterns — CLI tools are typically tested via stdin/stdout fixtures

Toolchain choice (uv vs pdm vs pip, ruff vs flake8, ty vs mypy) — see docs/recipes/python-toolchain-options.md for the three documented paths and the rationale for not bundling astral@astral-sh by default
